# InstiSupply

> InstiSupply is a Dubai-based institutional supplies business serving organisations across the United Arab Emirates.

InstiSupply provides recurring B2B and institutional supply support across six core categories: stationery and paper; printer and IT consumables; hygiene and tissue; cleaning and janitorial supplies; pantry and disposables; and PPE and safety supplies.

The business serves schools and universities, hospitals and clinics, corporate offices, facilities-management companies, factories and worksites across the UAE. Product brands, specifications, quantities, availability, pricing and delivery terms are confirmed through quotation.
